The current master still has the same structure. So the `xmlbase` global is still never set to point into namedata. So the xmlbase UAF isn't the issue.

Let me reconsider. The heap-use-after-free READ 1. Let me look at the `namedata` usage in the SSML_AUDIO case:

```c
if ((index = AddNameData(buf, 0)) >= 0) {
        uri = &namedata[index];
        if (uri_callback(1, uri, xmlbase) == 0) {
```

Here `uri = &namedata[index]` and then `uri_callback(1, uri, xmlbase)`. If `uri_callback` is set and calls `AddNameData` (which reallocs namedata), then `uri` would be invalidated. But in the fuzzer, `uri_callback` is NULL. So this path isn't taken.
